text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...I got a breakout on my skin.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"...I want to level it.
I want to make it completely flat...!"

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Still, I can't let it get any worse...
I have to bear with it...
Believe found herself troubled by rough skin...
